name: Colossyan
tagline: Colossyan is an AI video creation platform that generates professional-looking training and corporate videos using realistic AI avatars. It supports 70+ languages, script-to-video generation, and screen recording with AI presenter overlays. L&D teams use it to localise training content across global markets without reshooting.
